proposal: Single-storey rear extension to a semi-detached house

pages.text:
Site: 31 Wren Lane, Eastmere
Dwelling: semi-detached, 4 bedrooms
Proposal: single-storey rear extension, family room
Parking: two spaces, unchanged

The extension projects 4.6 m beyond the original rear wall.
Flat roof 3.2 m high with a roof lantern; render to match.
The oak in the rear garden is 9 m from the new wall; no works within its root area.

Oak T1 (TPO T/2019/07), stem diameter 640 mm.
Root protection area radius 7.7 m.
Foundations outside the RPA need no special design.
